# DevOps Paradox

> Weekly podcast co-hosted by Darin Pope and Viktor Farcic covering CI/CD, cloud infrastructure,
> Kubernetes, AI in software delivery, and developer experience. Episodes alternate between
> deep-dive discussions by the hosts and interviews with industry practitioners and open-source maintainers.

New episodes released weekly on Wednesdays, with 361 episodes and 200 livestreams published since 2019. Last updated July 1, 2026. For the complete content archive in a single file, see [llms-full.txt](https://www.devopsparadox.com/llms-full.txt).
